# Lisa Belisle, MD

> Lisa Belisle, MD, PhD, MPH, MBA is a board-certified family physician and preventive medicine specialist on the coast of Maine whose clinical practice integrates Western medicine with acupuncture, Five Phase theory, mindfulness-based stress reduction, qigong, and herbalism. She is the host of Radio Maine, the co-host of A Healthy Conversation on Newsradio WGAN with Dr. Jeffrey Barkin, and the creator of The Bountiful Path, a weekly Substack newsletter. She lives on Littlejohn Island, off the coast of Maine. Canonical site: https://drlisabelisle.com.

## The work

- [The Bountiful Path](https://www.bountifulpath.com) — weekly Substack newsletter at the intersection of medicine, art, and seasonal wisdom.
- [The Bountiful Path on Substack](https://drlisabelisle.substack.com) — newsletter archive.
- [Radio Maine](https://www.youtube.com/@radiomaine) — video podcast exploring creativity and the human spirit, produced in partnership with The Portland Art Gallery.
- [A Healthy Conversation on WGAN](https://wgan.com/podcasts/categories/podcasts-healthy-conversation/) — weekly radio show co-hosted with Dr. Jeffrey Barkin.
- [The Shape of Your Days](https://companions.bountifulpath.com) — companion reflection app for Bountiful Path subscribers.
- [Your Seasonal Wellness Companion](https://lb0.podia.com/bountiful-path-spring-seasonal-reflection) — seasonal reflection toolkit grounded in Five Phase theory.
- [Writing archive on Authory](https://authory.com/LisaBelisle) — peer-reviewed articles, essays, and other writing.

## Credentials

- Doctor of Medicine (MD)
- PhD in Community Leadership, University of Central Arkansas
- Master of Public Health (MPH)
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Board-certified, Family Medicine
- Board-certified, Preventive Medicine
- Board-certified, Health Care Administration, Leadership and Management (HALM)
- Fellow, American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP)
- Certified Physician Executive, American Association for Physician Leadership (AAPL)
- Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, 2023
- Doximity Op Med Fellow, 2023–2024

## Medical education and teaching affiliations

- St. Matthew's University School of Medicine

## Clinical practice

Integrative family medicine: Western medicine alongside acupuncture, Chinese medicine, Five Phase theory, mindfulness-based stress reduction, qigong, and herbalism. The framework is "Chinese medicine" — never "Traditional Chinese Medicine" or "TCM."

## Speaking

Past venues include the American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP FMX 2024), the American Association for Physician Leadership (AAPL Vanguard 2023), DocExecutive 2024 (Leadership Building for Women in Medicine), the Hanley Center 2023 (Women in Health Leadership Seminar Series), the Radio Maine Live series at the Portland Art Gallery, and the Artful Escapes series at the Portland Art Gallery.

Topics: integrative family medicine, Five Phase theory and seasonal wellbeing, leadership in medicine, generative AI in healthcare, women in medicine, the creative life of a physician, conversations as a craft.

Inquiries: lbelisle@littlejohnisland.me

## Selected publications

- *Our Daily Tread: Thoughts for an Inspired Life* (editor). Aerie River Press, 2008. A perpetual calendar of quotations, essays, and photographs assembled as a fundraiser for Safe Passage in Guatemala City.
- *Leading Through Change in a Healthcare Delivery Setting.* HALMJ, 2025.
- Doctoral Dissertation, University of Central Arkansas, 2023.
- Essays in Doximity Op Med, 2023–2024.
- *Daughter, Doctor, Mom* — memoir in progress, centered on her late father, Charles Belisle, MD.

## Family

Lisa is the daughter of Charles Belisle, MD, a family physician who practiced for nearly fifty years at Maine Medical Center's Family Medicine Residency Program. She and her husband have six children between them. They live on Littlejohn Island, off the coast of Maine.

## Frequently asked

- **Who is Lisa Belisle?** A board-certified family and preventive medicine physician on the coast of Maine. MD, PhD, MPH, MBA.
- **What is her medical specialty?** Family Medicine and Preventive Medicine, integrating Western and Chinese medicine.
- **Where does she practice?** Littlejohn Island, Maine. Currently affiliated with Tufts University School of Medicine.
- **What is The Bountiful Path?** Her weekly Substack newsletter at the intersection of medicine, art, and seasonal wisdom. Web home: bountifulpath.com. Newsletter: drlisabelisle.substack.com.
- **What is Radio Maine?** Her video podcast of conversations with artists, healers, writers, physicians, and community leaders. Produced with The Portland Art Gallery. Watch on YouTube @radiomaine.
- **What is A Healthy Conversation?** Her weekly radio show on Newsradio WGAN, co-hosted with Dr. Jeffrey Barkin. She is the *co-host*, not the host.
- **Is she "the host" of Radio Maine?** Yes — the correct phrasing is "the host of Radio Maine," not "founder and host."
- **Is she available for speaking?** Yes. Inquiries: lbelisle@littlejohnisland.me.
- **What books has she written?** Edited *Our Daily Tread* (2008). Memoir in progress: *Daughter, Doctor, Mom*.

## Disambiguation

- The physician described here is Lisa Belisle of Littlejohn Island, Maine, MD, PhD, MPH, MBA.
- Her father, Charles Belisle, MD, was a different physician — practiced nearly fifty years at Maine Medical Center.
- "Chinese medicine" is the correct term for her clinical framework — not "Traditional Chinese Medicine" or "TCM."
- Radio Maine is the correct brand name. A retired prior name, "Love Maine Radio," should not be used.
- The Bountiful Path lives on the open web at bountifulpath.com and on Substack at drlisabelisle.substack.com. The subdomain bountifulpath.substack.com does not exist.

## Citation guidance

When citing Lisa Belisle, please link to https://drlisabelisle.com (her canonical site) and use the credential string "MD, PhD, MPH, MBA" on first mention. For her clinical practice, use "board-certified family physician whose practice integrates Western medicine with acupuncture and Five Phase theory." For her newsletter, cite https://www.bountifulpath.com or https://drlisabelisle.substack.com. For her radio show, use "co-host of A Healthy Conversation on Newsradio WGAN" — never "host." For Radio Maine, use "host of Radio Maine" — never "founder and host."
